scripts.build: corepack pnpm build:chrome && corepack pnpm build:firefox
scripts.test: node --test scripts/browser-release-workflow.test.mjs scripts/chrome-release-metadata.test.mjs scripts/create-deterministic-archive.test.mjs scripts/firefox-candidate-provenance.test.mjs scripts/firefox-proof-status.test.mjs scripts/firefox-signing.test.mjs scripts/normalize-firefox-source-archive.test.mjs scripts/prepare-release-output.test.mjs scripts/signed-firefox-xpi.test.mjs scripts/verify-firefox-release-candidate.test.mjs && vitest run
scripts.test:e2e: corepack pnpm test:e2e:chrome && corepack pnpm test:e2e:firefox
scripts.test:e2e:chrome: corepack pnpm test:e2e:canonical-surface && corepack pnpm test:e2e:hosted-recovery
scripts.test:e2e:firefox: corepack pnpm build:firefox && playwright test -c tests/firefox-production/playwright.config.mjs && wxt build -b firefox --mv3 --mode e2e && AWSM_FIREFOX_EXTENSION_BUILD=.output/firefox-mv3-e2e AWSM_FIREFOX_EXPORT=true playwright test -c tests/firefox-production/playwright.config.mjs
scripts.test:e2e:cross-browser: corepack pnpm test:e2e:chrome && corepack pnpm test:e2e:firefox
scripts.test:e2e:canonical-surface: sh -c 'wxt build -c tests/canonical-surface/wxt.config.ts && playwright test -c tests/canonical-surface/playwright.config.ts; run_status=$?; wxt prepare; restore_status=$?; [ $run_status -eq 0 ] && exit $restore_status; exit $run_status'
scripts.test:e2e:design: wxt build --mode e2e && AWSM_EXTENSION_BUILD=.output/chrome-mv3-e2e LD_LIBRARY_PATH=.output/browser-libs${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:+:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH} playwright test -c tests/design/playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:firefox:feasibility: wxt build -c tests/firefox-feasibility/wxt.config.ts -b firefox --mv3 && playwright test -c tests/firefox-feasibility/playwright.config.mjs
scripts.zip: node scripts/prepare-release-output.mjs && corepack pnpm zip:chrome && corepack pnpm zip:firefox
scripts.zip:firefox: wxt zip -b firefox --mv3 && node scripts/normalize-firefox-source-archive.mjs .output/awsmbrowser-extension-$npm_package_version-sources.zip && node scripts/create-firefox-archive.mjs && node scripts/verify-firefox-release.mjs && node scripts/verify-firefox-archive.mjs
